exposure: presence of associated conditions (polyhydramnios, hydrops fetalis, dextrocardia)
type of management (conservative vs. surgical intervention)
cohort: Thirteen neonates diagnosed with Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformations (CPAMs) at a Tunisian tertiary referral center between 2019 and 2024.
finding: Even asymptomatic CPAM patients require close and prolonged monitoring due to potential late complications, and surgical intervention should be considered on a case-by-case basis.
